limitations: Local MOCK provider acceptance only; real ATS and external employer submission remain NOT_RUN/disabled.
No automatic takeover or fabricated completion of a RUNNING browser attempt; manual process-death confirmation/recovery for such a reservation remains a separate requirement.
PostgreSQL crash recovery skipped; these new scenarios use SQLite. No claim of new Redis or multi-host recovery acceptance.
Legacy API callers without request_id retain their original outbox identity and do not acquire the new frozen queue contract.
The existing Node v25.9.0 emits a Vitest supported-engine-range warning. Installed versions were not changed; tests and build actually passed.
implemented: Connected profile/application-scoped request persistence before POST.
Reload performs read-only GET and bounded status polling, never automatic POST or submission.
Visible operation state, saved request ID, safe same-request resend and explicit terminal-to-new-run action.
Queued/running cancellation controls and renewed consent for one fictional submission.
Storage failure and malformed recovery state fail closed; pending submission intent is not consent.

build.warning: Existing large-bundle warning; main JS is approximately 790 kB minified. No threshold was weakened.

observed_cases.observed: UI response deliberately lost after real API admission. Reload recovered the same ID with no extra POST. Real worker completed once; a later explicit new run admitted a different ID, resisted rapid double-click, and produced exactly one additional review.
UI cancellation and reload preserved CANCELLED, with zero physical attempts, zero provider reviews/submits, and one admission POST.
Submission disabled until checked. Reload did not POST. Actual worker confirmed one fictional submission, and a subsequent reload did not permit another run.

browser_egress: Each UI context rejected non-test-origin requests; all three scenarios asserted zero external requests.
